usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.admin.organization.invites.create(email="string", role="reader", projects=[{"id": "string", "role": "member"}])
print(result)

fields.name: email
fields.description: Send an email to this address

fields.name: projects
fields.description: An array of projects to which membership is granted at the same time the org invite is accepted. If omitted, the user will be invited to the default project for compatibility with legacy behavior.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.invite`

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: email
fields.description: The email address of the individual to whom the invite was sent

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the invite was sent.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the invite expires.

fields.name: accepted_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the invite was accepted.

fields.name: projects
fields.description: The projects that were granted membership upon acceptance of the invite.
